prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1420; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can use the claim reference.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision occurred?
A: I was driving through the intersection in Baytown, Texas, heading east on the main road. The light had just turned green for me.
Q: And what happened next?
A: A pickup coming from the cross street on my right didn't stop. It came straight into the side of my car, right behind the driver's door.
Q: Did you see the pickup before the impact?
A: Only for a second. I caught a glimpse of it and tried to brake, but there wasn't time.
Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?
A: No. The airbags went off and the car wouldn't handle right, so a tow truck took it away.
Q: Did you receive any medical attention?
A: The paramedics checked me at the scene. I went to the emergency room later that afternoon because my neck was really stiff.
Q: Can you describe your injuries?
A: I have a neck strain. It hurts when I turn my head, and I get headaches by the end of the day. I've been told to rest it and take muscle relaxers.
Q: Have you had any prior neck or back problems?
A: No, nothing that required treatment. I was healthy before this.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: Yes, a few days so far. My doctor has me on light duty for the next couple of weeks.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was following the traffic signal and I believe the other driver was at fault for not yielding.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
